title: Definition.
officialText:
The following term shall, for the purposes of this section and as used elsewhere in this code, have the meaning
shown herein.
RETRACTABLE AWNING. A retractable awning is a cover with a frame that retracts against a building or other structure to which
it is entirely supported.
